dedupe_keys.name: capacita di trattamento dell impianto di depurazione

description: Capacità di trattamento dell'impianto di depurazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Indicates the actual holding capacity of the equivalent inhabitants (AE) and means the load of a slurry that reaches the waste water treatment plant in one day (24 hours). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Treatment capacity of the sewage treatment plant" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include n.d., Utilizzo del territorio, Unità statistiche. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
